$comment: Feature catalogue for the honest progress score (plan §9/§10, U0.5). One row per feature in the product catalogue (plan §4c). REPLACES the .goal/goal.json percentage, which measures 29 foundation tasks and therefore flatters: it answered a much smaller question than 'how much of the product exists'. Never hand-edit a verdict here -- verdicts are DERIVED by scripts/catalogue-score.mjs from machine signals. The only hand-authored fields are `probes` (what would prove this feature real) and `manual` (a DOWNGRADE with a reason; upgrades are refused by the scorer).

rubric.REAL: every declared probe passes -- the route is live, the backing collection has real documents, the page exists, the package is reachable
rubric.PARTIAL: some probes pass, or a human downgraded a REAL with a recorded reason (e.g. it works but is materially incomplete)
rubric.STUB: code exists but returns 501/placeholder, or the package is dead code imported by nothing
rubric.honesty_rule: `manual` may only lower a verdict, never raise it. docs/PROGRESS.md reports the auto-derived score AND the adjusted score side by side, so how much is machine-proven vs human judgement is always visible.

manual.reason: URL-only. No file/recording upload, no consent checkbox, no 5-step Ingest->Index->Enrich->Verify->Publish status. Plan §10 U4.1.
List + detail are real, but there are no month/status/speaker/topic filters and no coverage %.
Document adapter is real and sources are populated, but there is no page-level evidence highlight, no detected-topics/orgs panel, no source quality score.
Only Google Calendar + Gmail, via the gws CLI. No Drive, Zoom, Teams or Sheets connector, and no per-source ingestion rules.
All three joiners (vexa/browser/system-audio) are explicit stubs and the package is dead code imported by nothing. The page honestly self-labels as not live. Plan §10 U4.2.

features.name: Web capture of public webinars (YouTube etc.)

manual.reason: Schema + accessor + schedule code exist, but nothing ever calls them -- no scheduler runs, so the collection is permanently empty. Code without a caller is not a feature.

features.name: Migrate TOC sessions with turn-level citations
Speaker identity resolution (aliases, orgs, roles, confidence)
features.note: WhatsApp turns do carry a real speakerLabel, but that is an INPUT to this feature, not the feature: the speakers collection (aliases/org/role/confidence) is empty and TOC turns are still spk:0. Scored MISSING deliberately — an earlier draft tried to call this PARTIAL and the scorer refused the upgrade. Plan §10 U2.4.

features.name: Vectorless tree index generator + incremental regeneration
Vector index for unstructured (hybrid semantic + keyword)

manual.reason: The Brain graph renders real tree_index nodes, but there is no year->month->session drill-down explorer and no overview/topics/speakers/orgs tabs.

features.name: POST /ask CRAG router (tree-search -> evaluator -> cited answer)

manual.reason: Works end-to-end and citations resolve to real sessions, but retrieval is tree-only -- there is no vector layer, so the 'two indexes' hypothesis H1 is half-built. Plan §10 U1.5.

features.name: Ask AI UI (evidence mode, filters, history)

manual.reason: The /ask page exists and drives a real question->answer flow, but this feature's own scope is not built: there is no evidence mode, no filters, no suggested questions and no history -- the page is a single stateless query box. The probe credits it REAL purely because a /ask page is present. Downgraded 2026-09-08 by the same session that shipped the page. Plan §10 U3.1 (its Playwright gate is also still unmet).

Internal-vs-web source separation IS real and mutation-tested (contract qa/contracts/web-ask-page.md C4). The rest of this feature is absent: no retrieval-confidence display, no coverage verdict beyond a raw insufficient_coverage flag, no evidence excerpts, no follow-ups, no feedback control. One of three parts shipped. Downgraded 2026-09-08 by the session that shipped the page.

features.name: Universal Search (sessions, moments, docs, decisions, speakers)
Unstructured Knowledge Search (structured + vector side by side)
Reports builder (exec summary / insights / decisions / risks)

manual.reason: Real stat tiles + recent sessions, but no coverage %, no internal-vs-web answer ratio, no knowledge-health score.

features.name: Activity & Knowledge Health (jobs, freshness, errors, retries)
Notification Center, saved views, scheduled digests
Counsellor eval harness (golden set, judge, leaderboard)

manual.reason: compete routes + eval_runs are real, but T-021/T-022 were PASSed against a HEURISTIC proxy, not a real LLM -- the recall@5 >= 0.85 target and real judge calibration have never actually been met. Plan §10 U0.10.

features.name: Loss -> gap -> capture -> re-index -> re-run flywheel
Multi-tenant hosting
features.note: Every collection carries tenantId and every accessor is tenant-scoped — real groundwork — but the tenants collection is empty and exactly one tenant ('toc') exists, so multi-tenant HOSTING is not a thing that exists yet. Scored MISSING deliberately; the scorer refused an earlier PARTIAL as an upgrade.

features.name: Auth, roles, permissions matrix, audit log

manual.reason: Scoped API keys are real (hashed, revocable, per-tenant). There are no users, no roles, no permissions matrix and no audit log.
